name: Onii-chan
source:
The protagonist. His name is displayed as Onii-chan though his sisters also call him Onii-san, or Nii-san. He loves all his sisters very much and when he finds out that his parents intend to separate him from them he's afraid he'll die.

Has the mysterious power to summon his twin sister wherever he is.

Has the mysterious power to summon his twin sister wherever he is.
